Reynisfjara black-sand beach at storm-break, the wide volcanic-sand arc stretching south beneath racing cloud, foreground black-pumice scatter with surf-foam fingers reaching inland, midground Atlantic breaker curling in a long white crest, distant Reynisdrangar columns dissolving into cool sea mist.

Þingvellir continental rift fissure at low-winter-sun, the deep basalt-walled crack between tectonic plates cutting through Icelandic-moss-covered volcanic ground, foreground close basalt rim with dense Racomitrium lanuginosum carpet, midground rift-valley floor in shadow receding to lake Þingvallavatn, distant Hengill volcano silhouette in blue atmospheric haze.

Vatnajökull ice cave interior at blue-glow, deep compressed-glacier-ice walls arching in ribbed flowing curves overhead, cool daylight entering through a narrow crevasse skylight above, foreground ice floor with a dark volcanic-ash band running diagonally, distant cave throat narrowing into deeper saturated blue.

Háifoss high waterfall at golden sidelight, the 122-metre glacial-silt-grey thread dropping sheer into a vast basalt canyon with neighboring Granni fall at left, foreground close basalt rim with dense moss carpet, midground twin falls dominant in full vertical height, deep canyon walls receding in blue atmospheric depth below.
